title: v1.54 is the last -a1compat image — a1.* nodes lose EBS support from v1.55

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: `v1.55.0` and later will not support `a1.*` instances.
remediation: Move workloads off a1.* (first-generation Graviton) nodes before upgrading — the driver from v1.55 does not support them and the -a1compat image is no longer published, so the node plugin on those nodes cannot run. Replace them with a current Graviton family (m7g, c7g, r7g, …) and drop -a1compat image overrides.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["node.kubernetes.io/instance-type"] // "" | startswith("a1.")) | .metadata.name'  # each printed node is an a1.* instance the driver drops in v1.55
